references.text: Nabal was from Maon, and his business was in Carmel. This verse mentions the same places, Maon and Carmel, as Joshua 15:55.
David sent men to Nabal in Carmel, which is the same city mentioned in Joshua 15:55 as one of Judah's cities.
David and his men were in the wilderness of Maon, which is the same Maon mentioned in Joshua 15:55.
David stayed in the wilderness of Ziph. Ziph is mentioned together with Maon and Carmel in Joshua 15:55.
Ziph and his descendants are mentioned in Caleb's genealogy. Ziph is one of the cities mentioned in Joshua 15:55.
Maon is mentioned as a son of Shammai in Caleb's genealogy, linking the name to the city of Maon in Joshua 15:55.
